# Annotation Guide

Use `--` for implementation comments, `---` for API prose, and `---@`
for Lua-compatible annotations. In native Tua code, prefer types on declarations
and signatures; annotation contracts must agree with native types.

Type `---@` to discover tags and hover a complete tag for its meaning.
In VS Code, run **Tua: Open Annotation Guide (Offline)** from the Command Palette.
Tag completion inserts the tag name without replacing your existing arguments.

Recognition does not imply full LuaLS semantics. The descriptions below state
which tags affect checking and which are metadata only. Enable
`[diagnostics] doc_annotations = true` in tua.toml to report malformed supported
tags. Use `-- tua-ignore-next-line CODE` for Tua diagnostic suppression.

## @alias

```lua
---@alias Name Type
```

Defines a named type alias.

## @class

```lua
---@class Name
```

Describes a Lua table type; this does not create a native Tua class.

## @field

```lua
---@field name Type
```

Adds a typed field to the preceding annotation class.

## @param

```lua
---@param name Type
```

Types a Lua function parameter. Native Tua annotations must agree with this contract.

## @return

```lua
---@return Type
```

Describes function return values.

## @type

```lua
---@type Type
```

Provides a type for a Lua declaration.

## @overload

```lua
---@overload fun(value: string): number
```

Adds a known call signature for signature help and call checking.

## @vararg

```lua
---@vararg Type
```

Types variadic Lua function arguments.

## @deprecated

```lua
---@deprecated Use replacement instead
```

Marks an API deprecated; uses report TL4056 and editor surfaces show the guidance.

## @nodiscard

```lua
---@nodiscard
```

Reports TL4068 for a direct call statement that discards the resolved function result.

## @generic

```lua
---@generic T
```

Metadata only. Does not provide generic type inference or generic classes.

## @version

```lua
---@version 5.1
```

Metadata only. Does not select a runtime or change checking.

## @enum

```lua
---@enum Name
```

Metadata only. Does not create a checked enum type.

## @meta

```lua
---@meta
```

Identifies configured type_libraries declaration modules; does not execute or install a runtime library.

## @module

```lua
---@module "module.name"
```

Metadata only. Does not import a module or resolve a runtime dependency.

## @diagnostic

```lua
---@diagnostic disable: undefined-global
```

Metadata only. Use Tua ignore directives to suppress Tua diagnostics.

## @cast

```lua
---@cast value string
```

Metadata only. Does not narrow or cast the value in Tua.

## @as

```lua
---@as string
```

Metadata only. Does not change expression inference in Tua.
